snippet.title: Hallowed Legends: Samhain Collector's Edition
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/1dB9NzA
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/1hSoUde

Robert was seeking a Celtic legend, but it found him first! Overcome the challenges and find your friend in this amazing Collector's Edition.

• DISCOVER A CELTIC SECRET!
Depart on a fantastic adventure and learn the secrets behind an ancient Gaelic festival!

• DESTROY AN ANCIENT EVIL
Celtic folklore seems to be more truth than lore when the Samhain festival goers disappear! Battle the gods of yore to restore the seasons and repair time.

• SOLVE PERPLEXING PUZZLES
Learn the truth behind the lore and find the missing people to save the day in this exciting Adventure game!

• GET ACCESS TO BONUSES BY UNLOCKING THIS COLLECTOR'S EDITION
Use the Integrated strategy guide to solve this mystery and then play the bonus chapter! Listen to the incredible sound track and check out the concept art that brought this story to life.

TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
